claims.source_url: https://www.nps.gov/places/big-badlands-overlook.htm (NPS place page); coordinate 43.78477,-101.89985 per map listing of the NPS overlook (Apple/Foursquare place data), retrieved 2026-11-09

pm_judgment.weather_light_dependency: 惡地尖峰成層列隊向東延伸，無光害、低緯乾燥——沙層紋理要靠低角度光才能浮出，銀河需要乾燥晴夜。

claims.source_url: https://www.nps.gov/acad/planyourvisit/cadillac-mountain.htm (NPS: summit 1530 ft / 466 m); coordinate 44.3526,-68.2260 per GNIS/Wikipedia summit coordinate, retrieved 2026-11-09

pm_judgment.weather_light_dependency: 美國東岸最高點；日出常在山谷/海霧之上，霧與雲量直接決定能否看到第一道曙光與群島。

claims.source_url: https://www.nps.gov/shen/planyourvisit/upload/Hawksbill_RoadTrail.pdf (NPS: Hawksbill 4,051 ft); coordinate 38.5550,-78.3950 per SummitPost Hawksbill Lat/Lon, retrieved 2026-11-09

pm_judgment.weather_light_dependency: 園內最高峰眺望台；山谷晨霧與能見度決定層脊全景，秋季視野最遠。

claims.source_url: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r05/inyo/recreation/south-tufa (USFS Inyo NF official: Lat 37.940344, Lon -119.028063, elevation 6,400 ft), retrieved 2026-11-09

pm_judgment.weather_light_dependency: 鹼水湖面的石灰華塔陣；湖面倒影要無風，銀河需要高原乾燥暗空。
漲潮時海水被吸入岩洞形成湧泉漏斗；潮位、湧浪與日落低角度光共同決定畫面。

claims.source_url: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multnomah_Falls (45°34′33″N 122°06′55″W; 620 ft / 189 m total) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r06/columbiarivergorge/recreation/multnomah-falls (USFS: 620-foot falls, flow highest winter/spring), retrieved 2026-11-09

pm_judgment.weather_light_dependency: 620 呎層疊瀑布；水量隨季節（冬春最豐）且全日題材需光線窗。
235 呎海蝕柱正面西方海平線；低雲/海霧與退潮決定剪影與前景倒影。
禿崖頂看拉法葉山脈縱景與峽谷雲霧；新英格蘭秋季的層脊雲霧是變數主體。

claims.source_url: https://home.nps.gov/places/miners-castle.htm (NPS place page); coordinate N46°29.73′ W86°33.11′ (46.4955,-86.5518) per Alger County listing, retrieved 2026-11-09

pm_judgment.weather_light_dependency: 蘇必略湖畔礦物染色的砂岩堡；湖面霧與低雲決定色帶清晰度。
